verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs show alert delivery to Slack channels and PagerDuty incidents triggered by error activity, so the core alert-destination capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows routing rules by project, environment or severity, or per-rule threshold triggers. Missing for 10: email notification evidence, routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds for new issue, frequency spike and affected-user count, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count

citations.quote: The Slack integration can send notifications to any Slack channel and allows you to take action on errors straight from Slack.
The PagerDuty integration creates incidents in PagerDuty when error activity is reported to BugSnag.
Get alerts in Slack, Microsoft Teams, or your team's communication tool.
